# 1 - Setup

```{r, setup, include=FALSE}

options(scipen=999)

pacman::p_load(
  data.table,
  tidycensus,
  mapcdatakeys,
  tidyverse,
  arrow,
  here
)

# File paths
# Paths
if (grepl('VM',Sys.info()[['nodename']])){
  base <- '//data-sync/Public/DataServices'
} else {
  base <- 'S:/Network Shares/K Drive/DataServices'
}

root <- paste0(base,'/Projects/Current_Projects/Projections/Projections_2028/Data/01_Regional_Control_Totals/')

raw.path <- paste0(root,'ma_state_base_data_2010_2020_v20261005/')

shop.path <- paste0(base,'/Projects/Current_Projects/Housing/StatewideHousingPlan/04_Analysis/Data/Working/Regional_Control_Totals/')

# Helpers
sun <- function(x){
  sort(unique(x))}
lun <- function(x){
  length(unique(x))}
sna <- function(x){
  sort(names(x))}

# RPA names
mpos <- unlist(c(mapcdatakeys::all_muni_data_keys |> select(mpo) |> unique()))

# Munis by RPA/MPO
munis <- all_muni_data_keys |> select(muni_id, rpa_acr, mpo) |> setDT()
nonmapc <- munis[mpo!='MAPC']

# 2020 Blocks / Munis / RPA / MPO
blks <- geog_xw_2020 |> 
  left_join(munis, by = 'muni_id') |> 
  select(bl20_id, muni_id, muni_name, rpa_acr, mpo) |> 
  mutate(block_id = as.character(bl20_id)) |> 
  setDT()

source(here('scripts/Projections.Functions.R'))

knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
```

# 2 - Load Base Table for 2020 Households and Population - New UrbanSim Model

```{r}

hh <- arrow::open_dataset(paste0(raw.path,'ma_state_base_data_2020_households.parquet')) |> 
  collect() |> 
  setDT()

pop <- hh <- arrow::open_dataset(paste0(raw.path,'ma_state_base_data_2020_persons.parquet')) |> 
  collect() |> 
  setDT()


vars.dec20 <- load_variables(2020, dataset = c("dhc")) |> setDT()
pop.vars <- dec.vars(vars.dec20, "SEX BY AGE FOR THE POPULATION IN HOUSEHOLDS")
pop.labels <- dec.labels("2020", "SEX BY AGE FOR THE POPULATION IN HOUSEHOLDS")

pop.vars <- 'P15_001N'

hh.vars <- 'P21_001N'

pop.values <- decennial_call(pop.vars, geog = "block", 2020) |> 
  setDT()

hh.values <- decennial_call(hh.vars, geog = "block", 2020) |> 
  setDT()

pums_vars_2023 <- c(
  "SERIALNO",
  "PUMA",
  "TYPEHUGQ",
  "TEN",
  "BLD",
  "SPORDER",
  "AGEP",
  "ESR",
  "WAGP",
  "SEMP",
  "PINCP",
  "HINCP",
  "ADJINC"
  )


pums2023 <- get_pums(
  state = 'MA',
  year = 2023,
  survey = 'acs5',
  variables = pums_vars_2023
)

saveRDS(pums2023, file.path(root,'PUMS','pums_2023_basic.rds'))

#Clean the 2020 Household Population data
hhpop.20 <- pa.values |> 
  filter(GEOID %in% GEOID.20$GEOID) |> 
  right_join(
    labels,
    by = c("variable"="name")
  ) |> 
  #Change the Census age category levels to match the ageCAT6 labels
  mutate(
    ageCAT6 = case_when(
      label == 'pop_Under_5_years' ~ '1',
      label == "pop_5_to_9_years" ~ '2',
      label == "pop_10_to_14_years" ~ '3',
      label %in% c("pop_15_to_17_years","pop_18_and_19_years") ~ '4',
      label %in% c("pop_20_years","pop_21_years","pop_22_to_24_years") ~ '5',
      label == "pop_25_to_29_years" ~ '6',
      label == "pop_30_to_34_years" ~ '7',
      label == "pop_35_to_39_years" ~ '8',
      label == "pop_40_to_44_years" ~ '9',
      label == "pop_45_to_49_years" ~ '10',
      label == "pop_50_to_54_years" ~ '11',
      label == "pop_55_to_59_years" ~ '12',
      label %in% c("pop_60_and_61_years","pop_62_to_64_years") ~ '13',
      label %in% c("pop_65_and_66_years","pop_67_to_69_years") ~ '14',
      label == "pop_70_to_74_years" ~ '15',
      label == "pop_75_to_79_years" ~ '16',
      label == "pop_80_to_84_years" ~ '17',
      label == "pop_85_years_and_over" ~ '18'
    )
  ) |> 
  filter(!is.na(ageCAT6)) |>  
  right_join(
    GEOID.20,
    by = c('GEOID')
  )
```
